fact: A Ministry of Digital Transition AI expert presented the national strategy for designing and deploying an AI model adapted to Burkinabe realities, on 12 August 2026.
The minister said the PACDIGITAL project, run by the Ministry of Digital Transition, provides substantial funding to set up AI centres of excellence and study grants.
Specialists at CITADEL, Virtual University of Burkina, developed a Mooré-to-French and French-to-Mooré translation tool, shown in a live demonstration on 21 October 2025.

On 15 October 2026 the Centre Citadel and the Data Lab launched L'Essentiel.bf in Ouagadougou, a free web and mobile platform that uses AI to collect, summarise and serve news from four national outlets every 15 minutes in French and Mooré, as text and audio (leFaso.net).
